notes: Data drops from TSA's daily checkpoint numbers (Jan 1, 2025 to Oct 22, 2026), the same data as leaveby.xyz/busiest-travel-days. 2 concepts x 2 hooks = 4 posts. Timely: the Sunday after Thanksgiving (Nov 29) is the likeliest day for a new record.

concepts.caption: Only 8 days in history have topped 3 million people through TSA. Every one was a Friday or a Sunday. The record: 3,134,613 on the Sunday after Thanksgiving 2025. Flying Nov 29? Plan for a crowd. Source: TSA checkpoint travel numbers. All 660 days charted at leaveby.xyz/busiest-travel-days
